page.layout: One page of text in a single column; below the text a diagram of two figures (a square lettered E, F and a rectangle lettered B, D) with a signature line "T 4 DI-" at the foot. Running head at the top; page number at the top right. No margin notes.

main_text.l: capacissimus est. Consulite Clavium in
sphæram Ioan. de Sacro B. cap. 1.
Eadem igitur quantitas absque rarefa-
ctione potest maiorem, & maiorem oc-
cupare locum, si nimirum varias, variasq;
subeat figuras, vt ex 35. primi Euclidis co-
nfirmari potest in parallelogrammatibus.
Hinc ingeniosa nequitia quispiam vi-
cino suo imposuit, cui erat ager quadra-
tus, qualis e. f. Ipse vero habebat qualis b.
d. persuasus n. antiquæ simplicitatis vir,
vt commutaret agrum, ratus æqualis esse
areæ, quod æqualis esset peripheriæ, inue-
nit experimento minùs fæcundum b. d.
quàm esset primus e. f. Discite hinc, posse
duas vrbes, quæ parem habeant ambitu,
esse magnitudine inæquales, vnde solent
falli qui magnitudinem loci ab externo
ambitu dimetiuntur. Demum aduertite,
hoc debere intelligi de quantitate secun-
dum lineas, quæ inuariata maius, minus-
què spatiū tenere potest; non de quantita-
te, quoad omnem dimensionem, quæ si maio-
re occupat locū, rarefcat etiam opus est.
E F B D T 4 DI-

page.notes: Diagram: square with corners E, F and rectangle with corners B, D, with small inner figures; the lettering is part of the drawing. Scan has show-through and stains; the signature line "T 4 DI-" is printed under the figures. Some words in the text are faint and may be misread, e.g. "maiore" and "rarefcat".
